title: Incorrect `erc20` transfer implementation between evm and core chains
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  In VaultEscrow, we will transfer users' deposit from EVM Chain to Core Chain and deposit into the related vault.  In function deposit(), we will transfer USDC tokens to precompiled system address `0x2222222222222222222222222222222222222222`. The system address will help us to transfer USDC tokens from EVM chain to the Core chain.
